securityFindings.title: Pull-request workflows execute PR-controlled code with live RPC secrets and write-capable token
securityFindings.evidence: Both workflows trigger on pull_request, check out the PR source, install/execute repository code, and expose live archive RPC secrets. github-native-sim-ci also grants issues: write and passes github.token to the health store.
securityFindings.requiredRepair: Split secretless pull-request validation from trusted live-fork jobs. Live jobs must run only through a trusted push/manual/reusable workflow against an explicitly reviewed SHA with least-privilege permissions.

securityFindings.title: Third-party GitHub Actions are referenced by mutable tags
securityFindings.evidence: actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4 and actions/upload-artifact@v4 are mutable references.
securityFindings.requiredRepair: Pin every third-party action to a reviewed full 40-character commit SHA and retain the version only in a comment.

securityFindings.title: Public issue comments can forge RPC health events and trigger prototype pollution
securityFindings.evidence: The repository is public. The store parses every comment containing the marker without validating author identity. The reducer accepts arbitrary slot IDs into a normal object; an event using slotId or entry.id __proto__ resolves Object.prototype and writes health fields onto it.
securityFindings.requiredRepair: Authenticate accepted comment authors/issuers, validate an exact event schema and bounded slot-ID grammar, reject prototype-sensitive names, and store slots in a null-prototype Map/object. Recovery/disable events must be authorized separately from session events.

securityFindings.title: Upstream RPC error text is returned to the local JSON-RPC client
securityFindings.evidence: Provider/network decoded error.message becomes the thrown error message and is emitted as JSON-RPC error.message. Such text can contain endpoint URLs, API-key-bearing paths, account identifiers or transport internals.
securityFindings.requiredRepair: Return stable bounded public error text and retain only a classified failure code in diagnostics. Never expose provider/network messages or URLs.

verdict.reason: Functional acceptance evidence is strong, but four external trust-boundary findings must be repaired and independently verified before the merged paths can be reconciled into the Round 4 candidate.

requiredNextSteps: Create a test-first security repair on an isolated branch from merge commit 500de7b8752e926f7478feafb81b92586d6364ea.
Regenerate the exact 41-path main reconciliation registry after the repair.
Run complete repository tests, syntax gates, workflow static security tests and live-fork acceptance on the repaired head.
Publish one exact repaired head and path/blob manifest for Worker 2 intake.
Worker 2 must not use the stale 20-path draft quarantine or freeze an assembled SHA before this reconciliation is accepted.
